correction_boundary: v2 identity, issue and winning-ticket ledgers are copied byte-for-byte and never recomputed; recovery does not open canonical outcomes

decision.rule: Pre-tax no_tax_roi is primary; tax-adjusted ROI is secondary. Largest issue/year controls use signed pre-tax net contribution and actual executed stake. Same-window positives are descriptive only and require strict independent EV plus held-out/forward validation; no purchase, production, betting or promotion authority.

drawdown_rule: pre-tax-primary and tax-adjusted-secondary net drawdowns are emitted separately
exclusion_rule: largest signed pre-tax net contribution among executed positive-stake rows; remove actual stake and both net variants
miss_streak_rule: frozen-calendar and executed-positive-stake streaks are emitted separately
scope: historical paper-only reporting recovery; no purchase, production, betting or promotion authority
